snippet.text: | `melian compare misses <range\|#pr> [--reason <reason>]... [--out <path>]` | Writes one miss for each defect no Melian finding matches, the first report of its group in site order that a person judged valid with a reason `--reason` names, as a JSON array of `{ name, repo, base, head, file, lines }`, the misses file `MELIAN_EVAL_MISSES` reads. `repo` is the clone's absolute path and `name` is `<changeset>-<finding ID>`. A GitHub review thread compared in several rounds comes from the last round that compares it, since its ID names the thread and so one defect in every round. A finding from a reviewer's file stays with its round: its ID hashes its path and `ref`, or its content, and a reviewer may reuse a `ref` for another defect in the next round, so no later round replaces it. Two costs follow. A file miss the reviewer withdrew in a later round stays in the export, and a defect a file reviewer reports again appears once per round, named `<round>-<finding ID>`. Both are accepted because a person reads the export and enters each miss's lines by hand before any measurement uses it; never feed the raw export to a measurement. A GitHub thread that an unattributed comparison shares with another comparison is left out and named, since nothing orders that comparison among the rounds. `--reason` takes `needs-execution`, the default, for the probing measurement; `owned-missed` for a lens's parity or goldens; and `no-owner` for a new rule or lens. Repeat it to write several. It refuses `out-of-scope`, since no lens owed such a miss, and any other word. It names on standard error each one with no lines at its compared head: no file or line, the base side, an outdated thread, or another commit. It also leaves out and names each miss the measurement tool could not place, as that tool checks it: a file the range does not change, or one missing, a link, binary or empty at the head, and lines past the file's end, since the tool refuses the whole file for one such miss. It writes nothing when no miss remains | `0` [cut at 2 KiB]
